description: FTA expert knowledge base (rules & experience) for SAA. Intentionally empty. Each entry in `rules` is one auditable line item. A future backend (for example a Cloudflare Worker) can serve the same shape from an endpoint; see SAA.loadExpertRules() in saa/index.html.

fields.clause: string. Sub-clause number, e.g. "8.4.2" (ISO 13485 purchasing is 7.4)
fields.requirement: string. The requirement, written in FTA's own words (never copied standard text)
fields.audit_question: string. Open question the auditor asks
fields.evidence: string[]. Objective evidence to request and review
fields.sampling: string. How many / which records, people and time periods to sample

examples.major: string. Example situation that would be graded Major NC
examples.minor: string. Example situation that would be graded Minor NC
examples.ofi: string. Example situation that would be an OFI

fields.common_findings: string[]. Typical findings seen in the field

reviewer.name: string. Who reviewed and signed off
